## Wave 2 Summary

The S105 GEM area-modular workshop CLOSED-AT-IDENTITY the original `G_τ = σ_t^ω` corridor (Tomita-Takesaki uniqueness on volovik's own §VII.BZ `f↔K` bijection) and, in doing so, produced one durable forward object: the **acoustic-frozen state ω'_z** — the SAME frozen GGE relic viewed from the near-acoustic-horizon frame, related to ω by a Bogoliubov (Hawking-dressing) transformation (Volovik §32). Wave 2 executes the workshop's three Remaining-Open-Questions as NEW-COMPUTE gates on this relocated object. The substrate IS the frozen GGE relic; ω'_z is that same relic Hawking-dressed; the horizon is NOT a surface in a container — it is the spectral floor `lam_horizon` of the named-block BdG spectrum, where the emergent acoustic metric `g_00^eff` degenerates.

Gate 2a (`S106-OMEGAPRIME-Z-CONSTRUCTION`) is the existence gate: it EXTRACTS the missing substrate input — the `g_00^eff(λ)` profile, constructed from the S47 acoustic-metric (Akama-Diakonov CF19) principle on the named-block D_K spectrum — then builds the Hawking-dressed occupation `f'_a = 1/(1+e^{K_a z_a})`, `z_a = 1/√(−g_00^eff(λ_a))`, emits ω'_z's own faithfulness witness (`0 < f'_a < 1` strict on every BULK mode), carries the floor mode explicitly empty-Fock (the GUARANTEED N₃=0 fixed point), and constructs `Δ_{ω'_z}^{it}`. Gate 2b (`S106-OMEGAPRIME-AREA-CLOCK`, GATED on 2a PASS) poses the SEPARATE area-clock question `‖K̂·z − Ĝ_τ‖_op < tol` testing `G_τ = σ_t^{ω'_z}` — a PASS is a NEW cross-pillar bridge CANDIDATE (future 5-anatomy registration), NOT a GEM-Q1 reopening. Gate 2c (`S106-CDGM-SPACING-CROSS-BLOCK`, independent, INFO-class) tests whether the surviving co-monotone-plus-shared-floor bridge's CdGM ladder-spacing `ω_0` is a cross-block invariant or a within-block accident.

### Admissibility guards (workshop pre-registration — VERBATIM, MANDATORY per cross-wave constraint 3)

**(a) Layer-1 identity guard (z-INDEPENDENT).** Any comparison this gate's output participates in is stated against `σ_t^{ω'_z}`, NEVER `σ_t^ω`. The `f↔K` bijection (Tomita-Takesaki) makes `ω'_z ≠ ω` for ANY `z ≠ 1`, so any downstream gate on `σ_t^{ω'_z}` tests `G_τ = σ_t^{ω'_z}`, NEVER the now-CLOSED `G_τ = σ_t^ω`. Stating the comparison against `σ_t^ω` is a CATEGORY ERROR independent of any numerical outcome (the ω-identity is CLOSED-AT-IDENTITY by Tomita-Takesaki uniqueness — S105 GEM-WORKSHOP Row 3).

**(b) Layer-2 faithfulness witness (z-DEPENDENT).** ω'_z's OWN faithfulness witness (`0 < f'_a < 1` strict on every BULK mode `{|λ_a| > lam_horizon}`) is emitted BEFORE any comparison. A `z` driving a BULK mode to empty-Fock (`f'_a → 0` or `→ 1` on a mode strictly above the floor) is FALSIFIED as a faithful relocation — the substrate-physics realization of PROHIBITED_ACTIONS Class 1 ("don't change the STATE until the comparison passes"). This is gate 2a's PASS predicate.

**(c) Floor-mode domain, interp (i) (boundary condition, NOT a discovery).** The floor mode `|λ| = lam_horizon = 0.8197411121` is carried EXPLICITLY empty-Fock: faithful strictly ABOVE the floor, empty-Fock AT the floor. This is the GUARANTEED N₃=0 Hawking-depletion fixed point (DSr3-1): `E_floor = Δ_B3 = 0.176 > 0` ⇒ `K_floor·z_floor → +∞` CLEAN (not `0·∞`). Pinned per interp (i) (W2-2 line 95/301: `lam_horizon = global min |λ| over the named blocks = the floor eigenvalue`) — so the construction is NOT PRU-vulnerable on the floor mode.

### Admissibility guards (workshop pre-registration — VERBATIM, MANDATORY per cross-wave constraint 3)

**(a) Layer-1 identity guard (z-INDEPENDENT).** The comparison is stated against `σ_t^{ω'_z}`, NEVER `σ_t^ω`. The ω-identity `G_τ = σ_t^ω` is CLOSED-AT-IDENTITY by Tomita-Takesaki uniqueness (S105 GEM-WORKSHOP Row 3); stating THIS gate's comparison against `σ_t^ω` is a category error independent of numerics. `σ_t^{ω'_z} ≠ σ_t^ω` for any `z ≠ 1` (the `f↔K` bijection), so even a PASS does NOT reopen GEM-Q1 — it establishes a NEW geometric-area-clock bridge for the Hawking-dressed relic.

**(b) Layer-2 faithfulness witness (z-DEPENDENT).** Gate 2a emitted ω'_z's faithfulness witness (`0 < f'_a < 1` strict on the bulk) BEFORE this comparison runs — the gating IS the structural enforcement. A `z` that closed this gate's gap by driving a BULK mode to `f'_a → 0` would have FAILED gate 2a (Layer-2 guard); the 2a→2b gating makes the "don't change the STATE until the comparison passes" discipline structural.

**(c) Floor-mode domain, interp (i).** The floor mode is empty-Fock (gate 2a), `K̂·z → +∞` there — EXCLUDED from the op-norm (bulk-only comparison, the floor contributes no finite generator value). The op-norm is computed on `{|λ_a| > lam_horizon}` only.

### A PASS is a CANDIDATE only — NO registration this session (cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md)

A PASS on this gate produces a cross-pillar bridge **CANDIDATE**, NOT a registered bridge. Any FUTURE registration of the acoustic-area ↔ Hawking-dressed-relic-modular-flow bridge REQUIRES the full 5-anatomy + 3-level ladder per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md`:
- **Element 1 (substrate-IS)**: `σ_t^{ω'_z} = Ad(Δ_{ω'_z}^{it})` on `(A_hor^{≤10}, H^{≤10}, D^{≤10})` — finite-L spectral-triple observable.
- **Element 2 (laboratory-IN)**: OPERATOR-EXPRESSION form required (integration domain + Tr + named projector) — NOT pinned this session (the lab-IN observable for the Hawking-dressed-relic area-clock is unspecified; EMr3-2 flags a 3He-B vortex-core companion as a separate future candidate).
- **Element 3 (bridge map)**: HKR / Connes-Karoubi / K-theory boundary — to be named at registration.
- **Element 4 (algebraic envelope)**: `L^{−α}` binding-vs-non-binding declaration required.
- **Element 5 (empirical anchor)**: numerical satisfaction at canonical L_max.
- **3-level ladder**: Level-1 (cohomology-class identity) / Level-2 (envelope) / Level-3 (anchor), with Level-3 < Level-2 for registry-PASS.

This session emits the CANDIDATE verdict ONLY; the 5-anatomy + 3-level registration routes to a FUTURE session. **No S106 mack falsifier-surface row** (cross-wave constraint 7: a PASS produces a NEW bridge candidate only; mack writes any bridge row at a future session, not S106).

Wave 3 does NOT consume Wave 2 outputs (cross-wave constraint 4: Wave 3 consumes S105 npz witnesses + registry state only; axis-orthogonal to Wave 2). The Wave-2-internal decision point is the 2a→2b intra-wave gating:

**2a→2b intra-wave gating (pre-declared mechanical closure per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`):**

| 2a verdict | 2b action |
|:-----------|:----------|
| **PASS** (ω'_z faithful-normal on bulk, floor empty-Fock clean, Δ_{ω'_z}^{it} built) | 2b DISPATCHES — run the area-clock op-norm comparison `‖K̂·z − Ĝ_τ‖_op < tol` |
| **FAIL** (a BULK mode driven to empty-Fock — ill-posed relocation) | 2b CLOSES HONESTLY: mechanical-closure script emits `S106-OMEGAPRIME-AREA-CLOCK: FAIL -- value='upstream_S106-OMEGAPRIME-Z-CONSTRUCTION_FAIL'` (PRE-REG-INC blocked-by-upstream pattern; per-gate-distinct audit_sha256; WP §W2-2 updated in the same run). The relocated corridor is closed at the existence step; the co-monotone-plus-shared-floor bridge remains the floor result. |
| **INFO** (g_00^eff not extractable from S47) | 2b CLOSES HONESTLY: `S106-OMEGAPRIME-AREA-CLOCK: PRE-REG-INC -- value='upstream_S106-OMEGAPRIME-Z-CONSTRUCTION_INFO_g00eff_not_nameable'` (the missing-ingredient boundary propagates; ω'_z stays a SEED). |

This gating is pre-declared at plan-authorship (NOT post-hoc plan editing — `mechanical-closure-discipline.md §"When mechanical closure IS acceptable"` item 1 satisfied): the plan anticipates the 2a-FAIL/INFO scenario and specifies the documented 2b outcome. 2c is INDEPENDENT and runs unconditionally regardless of 2a/2b.

**Branch summary for downstream:**
- 2a PASS ∧ 2b PASS → ω'_z is a faithful relocated object AND a NEW geometric area-clock bridge CANDIDATE (future 5-anatomy registration; NO S106 registry write). Dual-prior → 0.9 Track B.
- 2a PASS ∧ 2b FAIL/INFO → ω'_z faithful but the Hawking-dressed relic ALSO lacks a geometric area-clock; relocated corridor closed; co-monotone-plus-shared-floor is the floor result. Dual-prior → 0.9 Track A.
- 2a FAIL → ω'_z not a faithful relocation under the substrate g_00^eff; 2b mechanically closed; co-monotone-plus-shared-floor is the floor result.
- 2a INFO → g_00^eff not nameable from S47; ω'_z stays a SEED; 2b mechanically closed (upstream INFO).
- 2c (any branch) → the surviving bridge's rank-≥3-in-sector ladder-spacing clause is sharpened to a cross-block characterization (invariant ≤ 1e-2 / accident > 1e-2).
